rows.exactRefusal: Error: Expected instance of PDFDict, but got instance of undefined — thrown from PDFContext.lookup via PDFCatalog.Pages at PDFDocument.getPages, on both PDFDocument.load(..., { ignoreEncryption: true }) and finalizeFlatOverlay({ sourceBytes, expectedSha256 }), for CIV_EXP_02_A (f2820f713b9f8e0fb1c0095886e7184d56fda06eef7f65af014ab48922b7839a) and CIV_EXP_08_A (0f7666ac6877b4d482a71c5303ecb199792f713e3c728adb2308b86945505d5b). Preceded in both cases by a cascade of 'Trying to parse invalid object' / 'Invalid object ref' warnings, which is the signature of encrypted streams being parsed as plaintext.
rows.whyAPartialBuildWasRefused: The cover sheet alone is buildable. Delivering it would be a packet missing both required official components, including the proposed order, which is exactly the defect requiredComponentsMissing exists to catch. A packet that reads as finished and is not is worse than an honest stop.
rows.civExp02AResolvedByDigestNotFilename: CIV_EXP_02_A is stored as 'download.aspx.pdf' with formNumber null, and a byte-identical second copy sits beside it as '2download.aspx'. Both hash to f2820f713b9f8e0f..., so identity was settled on the digest and the filenames were not used.

registryBuildBlockerCarriedForwardNotUse.blocker: DE-5, buildBlockers[0] on trackId de_pardon_expungement, impact build_blocker, affectedElement eligibility_branch: 'How far § 4375 escapes § 4374's exclusions in practice, given that CIV_EXP_02_A is captioned to § 4374 and a separate after-pardon order form exists. Read Cornette and Gieck in full and get Lawrence's position.'
registryBuildBlockerCarriedForwardNotUse.whyItIsNotTheStopReason: Measured across the repository, 64 of the 275 families already built on disk carry a non-empty registry buildBlockers array, so a build_blocker of this kind is not a bar to reaching state_built in this factory; AGENTS.md's build-first review model puts counsel review after the build. It is recorded here for the reviewers, not used to justify the stop.
registryBuildBlockerCarriedForwardNotUse.butItIsSubstantive: It is worth counsel's attention precisely because it is visible on the face of these sources: CIV_EXP_02_A is captioned to § 4374 while this track files under § 4375, and Delaware publishes a separate after-pardon order (CIV_EXP_08_A). Whether the § 4374-captioned petition is the right primary filing for a § 4375 pardon expungement is unresolved in the record.

rows.whatWouldUnblockIt: A decision by the Captain and counsel on one of: (a) re-binding this family to unencrypted originals obtained from Delaware Courts, with new digests recorded in the registry, the manifest, the queue and a fresh acquisition receipt; or (b) adding a decryption-capable PDF engine to the factory (qpdf and mutool are not installed in this container; poppler's pdftotext and pdfinfo are, and they read these files, so the bytes are not damaged — only pdf-lib cannot open them), together with an explicit ruling that a factory-decrypted derivative may stand in for a court's published bytes. Neither is a build decision.
rows.whyEveryCounterIsNull: Nothing was built, so there is nothing to count. No fixture PDF, field map, field census, write report or blanks report exists for this family, and a zero in any of these nine would be a measurement this lane did not take. Zero writes is not the same fact as zero defects.
rows.measuredEncryptionDefect: Every Delaware Courts expungement instrument this family binds is published as an AES-256 encrypted PDF (pdfinfo: 'Encrypted: yes (print:yes copy:no change:no addNotes:yes algorithm:AES-256)'). pdf-lib 1.17.1, which is the only PDF engine any official_pdf_fill builder in this factory uses, carries no security handler at all: its parser reads /Encrypt into trailerInfo (node_modules/pdf-lib/cjs/core/parser/PDFParser.js:266) and never decrypts. `ignoreEncryption: true`, which every finalize path passes, suppresses the EncryptedPDFError throw and then parses ciphertext as though it were plaintext, which is why the failure surfaces as object-graph corruption rather than as an encryption error.
rows.howTheRefusalWasMeasured: Measured through the factory's own entry points, not inferred from the file header. Both PDFDocument.load(bytes, { ignoreEncryption: true, updateMetadata: false }) and finalizeFlatOverlay() from scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-official-form-finalize.mjs were called on the exact bound bytes. Control in the same run: the North Carolina AOC-CR-288 binary that the COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN nc_146_acquittal_petition-set builds from (sha256 776210116d1ee07a...), which is unencrypted, loaded and censused 128 AcroForm fields and 135 text items on the same code path in the same process.
rows.factoryPrecedentChecked: 186 distinct official documents are bound by exact SHA-256 across every source-receipt.json under data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1. Of the 34 that resolve to bytes on disk in this container, 33 are unencrypted and 0 are encrypted. This factory has never built an official_pdf_fill packet from an encrypted source, and holds no code path that could.
rows.noUnencryptedCopyExists: Every PDF under the mounted Delaware custody was hashed and probed. All four court-published instruments are AES-256 encrypted, as is CIV_EXP_06_A. The only two unencrypted Delaware PDFs in custody are FORM-1021IP (an instruction packet) and Delaware-RecordExpungement-Agent-Reference.pdf (an internal training reference); neither is a filing instrument and neither is bound by any of these families. The Master Library holds no Delaware CIV_EXP form PDF at all.
rows.whatWasNotDone: The source was not decrypted, re-saved, rasterized, print-to-PDF'd, reconstructed or substituted, and no builder script was written for this family. Decrypting would produce bytes with a different SHA-256 than the digest the track registry, the packet-set manifest, MASTER_QUEUE.json and the acquisition receipt all bind, so the packet handed to a participant would not be the instrument any controlling record names; it would also mean stripping a court's own change:no permission from its published form. Both are re-binding decisions for the Captain and counsel, not a build, and neither was taken here.
rows.whyNoBuilderScriptWasWritten: scripts/build-census-v1-de_pardon_expungement-set.mjs, scripts/build-census-v1-de_discretionary_superior_court-set.mjs and scripts/build-census-v1-de_discretionary_family_court-set.mjs were NOT created. A builder that cannot open its own sources cannot be run, cannot be tested and produces nothing, and committing three of them would leave scripts that read as an official_pdf_fill path for Delaware while being none. buildScriptExists stays false for all three, which is what SOURCE_READY_BUILDABILITY.json already records.
rows.sourceRecoveryWasNecessaryButNotSufficie: The 2026-09-04 acquisition archive was correctly recovered and correctly mounted, and this lane re-hashed all four Delaware originals and confirmed each against SOURCE_REMATERIALIZATION_REQUEST.json's expectedSha256 and expectedByteLength. The missing-bytes input is genuinely discharged. It was not, however, the only blocker: these three families would have stopped on the encrypted-source defect on 2026-09-04 as well.
rows.verdictIssued: none. This lane builds and stops; it verifies nothing and approves nothing.
